name: VIX Spikes: BRL & ZAR vs CNH Response
description: When VIX crosses above 25, how do high-carry EM currencies (BRL, ZAR) perform vs low-carry (CNH) over the next 10 and 20 trading days? Forward returns are inverted to show EM currency return (positive = EM strengthened). Includes day-by-day cumulative return path for the Aug 5, 2024 VIX spike event across all three currencies.
source:
# VIX Spikes: BRL & ZAR vs CNH Response
# When VIX crosses above 25, compare 10d and 20d forward returns
# for BRL/ZAR (high-carry) vs CNH (low-carry)
# Returns inverted: positive = EM currency strengthened vs USD
# Includes day-by-day return path for the Aug 5 2024 VIX spike

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
ts = index().value

# VIX (shared context — same signal for all assets)
vix = common_indices(ticker=ReferenceIndex.VIX)()
vix_close = ffill(vix.c)

# --- VIX Spike Detection ---
# Manual crossover: VIX crosses above 25 (was at/below, now above)
vix_prev = vix_close >> 1
is_spike = (is_valid(vix_close) and is_valid(vix_prev) and vix_close > 25.0 and vix_prev <= 25.0)

# --- Forward Returns (EM currency perspective) ---
# USD/EM forward return, then negate: positive = EM strengthened
fwd_10d_raw = forward_returns(period=10)(close)
fwd_20d_raw = forward_returns(period=20)(close)

# Invert: negative USD/EM return = positive EM return
fwd_10d = -1.0 * fwd_10d_raw
fwd_20d = -1.0 * fwd_20d_raw

# Filter to spike events only
spike_fwd_10d = where(is_spike, fwd_10d)
spike_fwd_20d = where(is_spike, fwd_20d)

# VIX level at spike for event markers
spike_vix = where(is_spike, vix_close)

# --- Carry group label for event markers ---
is_high_carry = is_asset_ref(tickers=['USDBRL', 'USDZAR'])().result
carry_group = conditional_select(is_high_carry, "High-Carry", "Low-Carry")

# --- Aug 5, 2024 Spike Detection ---
year = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.year)(ts)
month = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.month)(ts)
day = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.day)(ts)
is_aug5_spike = (is_spike and year == 2024 and month == 8 and day == 5)

# Forward returns at each horizon 1-20d for the return path
fwd_1d = -1.0 * forward_returns(period=1)(close)
fwd_2d = -1.0 * forward_returns(period=2)(close)
fwd_3d = -1.0 * forward_returns(period=3)(close)
fwd_4d = -1.0 * forward_returns(period=4)(close)
fwd_5d = -1.0 * forward_returns(period=5)(close)
fwd_6d = -1.0 * forward_returns(period=6)(close)
fwd_7d = -1.0 * forward_returns(period=7)(close)
fwd_8d = -1.0 * forward_returns(period=8)(close)
fwd_9d = -1.0 * forward_returns(period=9)(close)
fwd_10d_path = -1.0 * forward_returns(period=10)(close)
fwd_11d = -1.0 * forward_returns(period=11)(close)
fwd_12d = -1.0 * forward_returns(period=12)(close)
fwd_13d = -1.0 * forward_returns(period=13)(close)
fwd_14d = -1.0 * forward_returns(period=14)(close)
fwd_15d = -1.0 * forward_returns(period=15)(close)
fwd_16d = -1.0 * forward_returns(period=16)(close)
fwd_17d = -1.0 * forward_returns(period=17)(close)
fwd_18d = -1.0 * forward_returns(period=18)(close)
fwd_19d = -1.0 * forward_returns(period=19)(close)
fwd_20d_path = -1.0 * forward_returns(period=20)(close)

# Filter to Aug 5 spike only
aug5_1d = where(is_aug5_spike, fwd_1d)
aug5_2d = where(is_aug5_spike, fwd_2d)
aug5_3d = where(is_aug5_spike, fwd_3d)
aug5_4d = where(is_aug5_spike, fwd_4d)
aug5_5d = where(is_aug5_spike, fwd_5d)
aug5_6d = where(is_aug5_spike, fwd_6d)
aug5_7d = where(is_aug5_spike, fwd_7d)
aug5_8d = where(is_aug5_spike, fwd_8d)
aug5_9d = where(is_aug5_spike, fwd_9d)
aug5_10d = where(is_aug5_spike, fwd_10d_path)
aug5_11d = where(is_aug5_spike, fwd_11d)
aug5_12d = where(is_aug5_spike, fwd_12d)
aug5_13d = where(is_aug5_spike, fwd_13d)
aug5_14d = where(is_aug5_spike, fwd_14d)
aug5_15d = where(is_aug5_spike, fwd_15d)
aug5_16d = where(is_aug5_spike, fwd_16d)
aug5_17d = where(is_aug5_spike, fwd_17d)
aug5_18d = where(is_aug5_spike, fwd_18d)
aug5_19d = where(is_aug5_spike, fwd_19d)
aug5_20d = where(is_aug5_spike, fwd_20d_path)

# --- Output 1: VIX Context Line ---
# Shows VIX over time with 25 threshold — where are we?
xy_lines(
    title='VIX Level — Spike Threshold at 25',
    category='VIX Spike EM Response',
    y_axis_label='VIX',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='VIX', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=25.0, color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Spike Threshold')
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=vix_close)

# --- Output 2: Grouped Bars — Median Forward Returns by Asset ---
# The punchline: how does each EM pair respond after VIX spikes?
cs_bars(
    mode=CSBarMode.grouped,
    agg=AggregationType.Median,
    title='How Do EM Currencies Respond After VIX Spikes?',
    category='VIX Spike EM Response',
    y_axis_label='Median EM Currency Return',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series_names=['10-Day Return', '20-Day Return'],
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=2
)(values=(spike_fwd_10d, spike_fwd_20d))

# --- Output 3: Aug 5 2024 Spike — Day-by-Day Return Path ---
cs_labeled_lines(
    title='Aug 5 2024 VIX Spike: EM Currency Return Path',
    x_labels=['1d','2d','3d','4d','5d','6d','7d','8d','9d','10d','11d','12d','13d','14d','15d','16d','17d','18d','19d','20d'],
    x_axis_label='Days After Spike',
    y_axis_label='Cumulative EM Return',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    category='VIX Spike EM Response',
    colors=[Color.Blue, Color.Orange, Color.Gray],
    y_reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    smooth=True,
    data_labels=True,
    order=3
)(aug5_1d, aug5_2d, aug5_3d, aug5_4d, aug5_5d, aug5_6d, aug5_7d, aug5_8d, aug5_9d, aug5_10d, aug5_11d, aug5_12d, aug5_13d, aug5_14d, aug5_15d, aug5_16d, aug5_17d, aug5_18d, aug5_19d, aug5_20d)

# --- Output 4: Event Markers — Each VIX Spike ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='VIX Spike Above 25',
        icon=Icon.AlertTriangleIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Carry Group', type=CardRenderType.BadgeFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title='VIX Level', dp=1, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='10d EM Return', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='20d EM Return', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(carry_group, spike_vix, spike_fwd_10d, spike_fwd_20d, is_spike)
